items.article: A member of Trump's family addressed a risk that the White House has largely sought to downplay: The Iran war could cost Republicans the midterms. President Donald Trump's daughter-in-law addressed a possibility that the White House has largely sought to downplay: The war in Iran could cost Republicans the midterms. In an appearance on the YouTube show " Harry Cole Saves the West " on Wednesday, Lara Trump , who is married to Donald Trump's son, Eric Trump , spoke about the possible impact of the war on the midterms as Americans contend with the conflict's rising economic toll. On his show, Cole asked the Fox News host and former cochair of the Republican National Committee about Donald Trump's handling of the ongoing war, saying that it "could cost him his legacy." "Well, it could cost him these midterms," Lara Trump said. "I think Donald Trump's legacy has yet to be written, and I think that in a lot of ways — I still say he's going to go down in history as one of the greatest presidents, if not the greatest America has ever seen — but you're right. The last two years really matter." At the White House on Thursday, Donald Trump was asked if he agreed with his daughter-in-law's political assessment. items.article: A surge in startup exits and stock gains fuelled Bengaluru's premium housing boom from 2021 to 2024. Now, slowing price growth and tech sector headwinds are prompting buyers to rethink the equity-to-property playbook. This is a Mint Premium article gifted to you. Subscribe to enjoy similar stories. When Shreyas Nair, 33, sold a company he built which helped other startups scale from zero to $10 million in revenue, the proceeds left him heavily concentrated in equity. In 2025, he decided to put some of that wealth into an under-construction project in East Bengaluru with handover expected in March 2027.
